Spare parts for Ford truck maintenance

At EKS LKW you can request parts for the whole range of Ford Trucks rigid trucks and tractor units, for services, maintenance and repairs. The quote can include genuine and aftermarket parts. The manufacturer, fitment and availability are stated for every request.

Clutch and gearbox

A clutch job on a Ford Trucks rigid or tractor unit may need the clutch disc, pressure plate, release bearing or release fork. Configurations differ, so the part number and the truck data matter before choosing a kit. You can also ask for gearbox and driveline parts.

Brakes, suspension and steering

Brake discs and pads, calipers, air brake components, air springs, shock absorbers and joints are among the groups you can request a quote for. Parts are selected by application, without assuming they fit every Ford Trucks configuration.

Filters, engine and cooling

For servicing, send a list of oil, air and fuel filters, gaskets, pumps or cooling system parts, with the part numbers you have and the quantities. If a number does not show up in the search, contact us; the database does not cover every part we can supply.

Cab and body

For the cab and body you can request mirrors and mirror glass, headlamps and lamps, bumpers and their parts, wings, steps, grilles, deflectors, hinges, locks, window regulators and interior trim. For these parts the fitting side (left or right), the cab version and, for painted parts, the colour matter. A photo of the part in place and of its label helps us identify it correctly.

Electrics and lighting

Alternators, starters, sensors, switches, relays, wiring and lighting are identified most reliably by the number on the part and by the connector. If the label is no longer readable, send a photo of the connector and of where the part is fitted.

Parts for the whole Ford Trucks range

We supply parts on request for the whole range of Ford Trucks rigid trucks and tractor units: Cargo, F-MAX, F-LINE and vehicles for haulage, construction and special applications. Depending on the part number, parts come from stock or are sourced for you; availability and lead time are confirmed in the quote.

Parts for bodies and mounted equipment

On request we can also source parts for equipment mounted on the truck: refuse compactors, water or fuel tanks, pumps and other bodies. The body is often made by a manufacturer other than Ford, so we identify the part by the equipment's make, model, serial number and documentation.
